bindings.label: Patient developed fever, erythematous maculopapular eruption with keratosis pilaris on limbs and trunk, and facial photosensitivity on day 9 of treatment
Patient is a man in his 70s with stage IV melanoma with hepatic and lymph node metastasis, receiving vemurafenib 960 mg twice daily as first-line treatment
Fever with body temperature 38.6°C (101.5°F) occurred on day 9 of treatment
Physical examination showed erythematous maculopapular eruption with keratosis pilaris on all 4 limbs and trunk involving 30% of body surface area, and photosensitivity on the face
Laboratory tests show renal electrolyte wasting
No infectious exposure or positive cultures have been identified
Patient has drug reaction with eosinophilia and systemic symptoms (DRESS) syndrome
